title: Flock device inventory and purchases since February 2026
summary:
Temporal follow-up to the February 2026 device-list production under W012201-022326. Asks for:

- Item 1: devices installed, activated, replaced, relocated, decommissioned, or taken offline since 2026-02-01, with location (prior and new, for relocations), device type/model, ALPR capability, date of change, and records documenting the reason.
- Item 2: invoices, purchase orders, order forms, quotes, and contract amendments with Flock Safety dated on or after 2026-02-01, including installation fees or charges beyond the MSA and Amendment No. 1.
- Item 3: the current full device list — location, model designation (Falcon, Condor, Picard, or other), ALPR capability, ownership status (SMPD-owned, community camera, or other), and installation date.
- Item 4: communications with Flock Safety since 2026-02-01 requesting additions, removals, or corrections to the device information shown on the transparency portal, and records of when those changes were completed.

policy_promises.quote: implement a usage and privacy policy ... that includes the location of the ALPR system
policy_promises.tests: Whether the Department maintains a current, complete device inventory distinguishing ALPR-capable devices from non-ALPR cameras.
What purchase and amendment records exist for device changes made outside the MSA and Amendment No. 1.

prior_pra_refs.note: Produced the 2026-02-26 device list; item 3 asks for the current list in the same form.

filed_because: The February 2026 device list is the last full inventory on the record. Item 4 tests the Department's February statement that two decommissioned devices would be deducted from the transparency site and that cameras marked "in planning" were rejected locations Flock was working to remove — asking what was actually communicated to Flock and when the changes were completed.
